messages:
anna chen: Quick follow-up from the compaction RFC — hit a nasty race in stage where compaction handoff to hostbacking and KV-cache build interleave. Repro is intermittent but reliable under high tenant churn.
devon: ugh ok, can you paste repro steps?
ravi: saw similar flake in nightly, maybe related to prefetch + compact ordering.
anna chen: Repro steps: 1) allocate slab pages A,B; 2) mark A for compact -> move to new offset; 3) before migration complete, a worker copies pointer to old A into tenant KV cache; 4) migration finishes and hostbacking pins new page -> old pointer becomes dangling. nvprof shows missing fence.
devon: short-term mitigation?
anna chen: We tried adding a full device sync (cudaDeviceSynchronize) around compact. Fixes correctness but adds ~5% tail latency on text generation P50->P95 tail. Not acceptable for Hosted.
sam: Could we do epoch tokens per-slab instead of heavy device sync? Bump slab.epoch on compact start; any hostbacking pin reads epoch and retries if mismatch.
ravi: epoch helps but fails when prefetch races: the cache copy can happen after epoch read but before pointer resolution. Need state-check at pointer level.
devon: Proposal: add a compact handshake state machine to page descriptor with atomic transitions: OWNED -> COMPACTING -> MIGRATING -> HOSTPINNED -> OWNED. Use CAS to move states and have hostbacking pin check and CAS from MIGRATING -> HOSTPINNED.
anna chen: That sounds safer. Fast-path remains for OWNED->HOSTPINNED if page never touched by compaction. Pseudocode:\n\n```\n// simplified\nif (CAS(page.state, OWNED, HOSTPINNING)) {\n  pin_to_host(page);\n  CAS(page.state, HOSTPINNING, OWNED);\n} else if (page.state == COMPACTING) {\n  wait_for_state_change_or_retry(page);\n}\n```\n\nThis avoids global GPU sync but needs a bounded retry/backoff.
sam: We also need tenant-level backpressure: if a tenant triggers too many retries we should throttle prefetch or reject extra prefetch requests. Otherwise a noisy tenant causes others to stall.
ravi: Telemetry we should add: compact_retries, compact_backoff_ms, hostpin_fallbacks. Also an event when we escalate to full sync.
anna chen: Performance question: CAS path cost vs a device sync. CAS + a small busy-spin should be way cheaper normally, but in worst case (high contention) we must detect and fall back to serialized compaction to avoid livelock.
devon: Agree. Implementation plan: 1) prototype CAS state machine + unit tests (devon), 2) add telemetry + alert (ravi), 3) tenant prefetch throttling policy proposal (sam). If prototype shows >1% tail, we iterate with epoch hybrid.
infra-bot: Link to staging run with repro: https://staging.rw-inference/internal/compact-handoff/1719800000 (logs attached)
anna chen: I'll start a small PR with page-state layout and test harness, tag you all. Let's keep the handshake scoped to hostbacking/compact boundary to limit blast radius.
devon: SGTM. If someone can pair on the flaky test later today that'd help.
sam: I can pair at 4pm PT. I'll bring a short microbench to compare device-sync vs CAS-path.
anna chen: Thanks — capturing action items in thread.
